newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee trims losses as shorts cover.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee trims losses as shorts cover.

text.p: LIFFE coffee futures turned calmer after Monday's hectic session and prices ended Tuesday midession with pared losses on late short-covering.
The market gapped lower $55 but well above trade expectations of $130 down.
A fresh wave of spec profit-taking took benchmark July to a session low of $2,026, hitting a few sell-stops as the market fell below Monday's low of $2,100 and last week's double-bottom of $2,065.
But it managed to fight back to end the morning trade at session's high of $2,085, still a $25 loss.
Traders said roaster buying, which was the main feature in the past few sessions, was noticably absent this morning.
"While they may have some outstanding price fixings to do, I think the pressure is now off," said one.

Traders said the market now needs some consolidation after the big drops seen in the past few days as it corrected sharply from last week's dazzling rally which took New York to a 20-year high and London to its strongest in 20 months.
"But we are still well above the levels seen in the beginning of the year," said one.
But traders said after the severe falls, it would need some time for bruised long holders to regain their confidence.
There was no fresh fundamental news. The Brazilian weather is still the main issue.

Broker GNI said the cold front due to hit the coffee areas in Brazil this weekend was still worth watching, but most forecasters believed that there would still be sufficient cloud cover to prevent a frost. -- Jalil Hamid, London newsroom +44 171 542 4985
